## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and each one does one thing
- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix includes a test that failed before the fix)
- [ ] No new analyzer/lint suppressions, or each one has a comment explaining why
- [ ] Docs, runbook or ADR updated if behavior, operations or architecture changed
- [ ] No secrets, connection strings or personal data in code, config or logs
- [ ] UI changes: screenshots (light and dark, phone width) and Storybook story updated
